title: 顧問諮詢
intro: 設計、IP 授權、跨國市場、AI 工具——二十年橫跨創意與商業的實戰經驗,幫你把好點子變成能落地、能賺錢的計畫。
intro_en: Design, IP licensing, cross-border markets, AI tools — two decades of hands-on experience spanning creative work and business, helping you turn a good idea into a plan that ships and makes money.

items.title: 頂尖設計背景
items.text: 洛杉磯 Art Center College of Design 畢業,曾任迪士尼(Disney)、社交遊戲大廠 Zynga 資深概念設計師。
items.text_en: Graduate of Art Center College of Design in Los Angeles; former senior concept designer at Disney and social-game giant Zynga.

items.title: IP 授權經紀實戰
items.text: Hu Creates 胡創創辦人,專業藝術與 IP 授權經紀;代理《胖虎》《鯊魚先生》《Sharkitty》等 IP。
items.text_en: Founder of Hu Creates, a professional art & IP licensing agency representing IP including Alexander the Fat Tiger, Mr. Shark, and Sharkitty.

items.title: 連結亞洲與國際
items.text: 長期把亞洲藝術家帶向歐美市場、也把歐美 IP 引進亞洲,熟悉跨國授權與合作眉角。
items.text_en: Years of bringing Asian artists to Western markets and Western IP into Asia — fluent in the details of cross-border licensing and partnerships.

items.title: 企業顧問經歷
items.text: 曾任 遊戲橘子、網銀國際、ASUS、紅心辣椒、夢想動畫、好奇心創意 等企業顧問。
items.text_en: Consulting experience with Gamania, WANIN International, ASUS, Cayenne Entertainment, Moonshine Animation, and Curiosity Creative.

items.title: IP 授權策略
items.desc: 角色 / 圖像怎麼商業化、找對合作對象、談授權條件與分潤,避開常見的法律與合約地雷。
items.desc_en: How to commercialize a character or artwork, find the right partners, negotiate licensing terms and royalty splits, and avoid the common legal and contract pitfalls.

items.title: 藝術家經紀與媒合
items.desc: 幫創作者評估作品的市場潛力,規劃如何把作品帶進品牌合作與國際市場。
items.desc_en: Helping creators assess their work's market potential and plan how to bring it into brand collaborations and international markets.

items.title: 概念設計 / 藝術指導
items.desc: 遊戲、動畫、角色的美術方向與風格定調,從概念到落地的製作流程建議。
items.desc_en: Art direction and style for games, animation, and character design — from concept through production process guidance.

items.title: AI 工具導入
items.desc: 用 AI 優化你的創作與營運流程——就像我幫自己做的那些工具,幫你找出可以自動化的地方。
items.desc_en: Using AI to streamline your creative and operational workflows — the same way I built the tools I use myself — helping you find what can be automated.

pricing.heading: IP 顧問服務方案
pricing.note: 填一下需求,即可看到完整報價;實際方案可依需求討論調整(以下均為未稅)。
pricing.note_en: Fill in your needs to see the full pricing; plans can be adjusted based on your requirements (all prices below are pre-tax).

tiers.name: 方案一｜小時制顧問
tiers.label: 按小時計費
tiers.desc: 適合臨時需要專業建議、短期專案或階段性諮詢。
tiers.desc_en: Best for ad-hoc professional advice, short-term projects, or milestone-based consulting.
included_en: Key takeaways and recommendations summarized afterward

tiers.name: 方案二｜固定月顧問
tiers.label: 月費制
tiers.desc: 穩定、持續的深度合作,追蹤並優化你的 IP 策略。
tiers.desc_en: Ongoing, in-depth collaboration to track and refine your IP strategy over time.
included: 每週一次會議(1.5–2 小時)
或涵蓋 2 個 IP 的顧問服務
深入討論市場、授權、策略
附帶基礎提案與規劃建議
included_en: In-depth discussion on market, licensing, and strategy
Includes basic proposal and planning recommendations

cta.heading: 預約諮詢
cta.text: 想聊聊?先填一份簡單的諮詢需求,我看到後會親自跟你聯繫、確認方向與時間。為了讓諮詢更有效率,建議先把相關資料與想問的問題整理好。
cta.text_en: Want to talk? Fill in a short form first — I'll personally follow up to confirm direction and timing. To make the conversation more effective, it helps to have your background info and questions ready beforehand.
